content.title: Surface-Line Growth | Trace Geometry, Become a Keepsake
content.summary: Grow a colored line along the existing geometry of a physical carrier, then spread the same mark family across several carriers without hiding their outlines. Gather the line into a handmade keepsake and close it physically.

quick_start.input_format: Real carrier + trace along the existing geometric line + same line family across carriers + retain outline + hand-made souvenir closure
quick_start.recommended_input: The copper-colored embroidery thread first grows along the seams of the ceramic prototype, and then forms consistent functional marks across the four prototypes. Finally, it is bound into a physical material sample book and locked.
required_anchors: Begin the mark by tracing existing carrier geometry.
Spread marks while preserving the carrier silhouette.
Change carrier while retaining the mark behavior.
Collect the journey into a handmade keepsake and physically close it.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Grow a colored line along the existing geometry of a physical carrier, then spread the same mark family across several carriers without hiding their outlines. Gather the line into a handmade keepsake and close it physically.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Place one recognizable real carrier in frame, let a colored line trace existing geometry before spreading into icons or material marks without erasing the silhouette, use the same line family to bridge to new carriers, then collect the accumulated journey into one handmade keepsake and close it physically.

invariants.purpose: Binds intervention to the real surface.

invariants.ablation_failure: One surface cannot demonstrate a transferable system.

invariants.purpose: Creates a loop from world surface to held object.
invariants.ablation_failure: A final random landmark adds no structural payoff.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is clear without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: causal_carrier
slots.constraint: One object, route, mark or device that visibly carries the causal chain.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: Five ordered states with observable handoffs, not a decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A new proof-oriented information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final consequence that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of story-world cues supporting each visible change.

anti_copy_exclusions: source world landmarks and neon crayon doodles
Eiffel Tower, Big Ben, Colosseum, Opera House and pyramids
source globe sketchbook and closing hand
the exact travel-icon order and drawings
